entities.summary: Emi Kusano is a Japanese multidisciplinary artist based in Tokyo. She uses artificial intelligence in retro-futuristic artwork. In a collaboration with Christie's New York, an auction house, and Gucci, she unveiled an AI-generated 3D dress. Emi Kusano was a composers & musicians from Tokyo (b. 1990-08-04, Tokyo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
